monitoring.securityDashboardAlert: One-screen view of security events and open risks. Resolutions are written to the audit hash chain; enterprise compliance package only
monitoring.persistenceAlert: The gateway keeps data after restart by storing it in shared storage. Where to store is a one-time deployment decision (Redis / built-in database / local files); standalone deployments can ignore this tab
monitoring.templatesAlert: Vendor presets shared by provider selection and the template-based wizard. No daily changes needed
monitoring.categoriesAlert: Override default settings per model category. Defaults from global settings apply when empty
monitoring.adaptersAlert: Chosen automatically when connecting a new vendor; only needed when a vendor API is non-standard

securityDashboard.locked: Security Posture is not unlocked by the current license (enterprise compliance package)
securityDashboard.loadFailed: Failed to load posture data. Check that the enterprise license enables this capability
securityDashboard.resolveNoteTip: Provide a note. The resolution is recorded in the audit hash chain
securityDashboard.resolveConflict: Already resolved or missing. Refresh and retry
securityDashboard.noRisks: No high-risk events in this window
